Seat the twelve hulls the trail-volume lever already balanced (Meerkat, Wrasse, Urchin, Honeyguide, Stoat, Sparrow, Scarab, Squirrel, Dolphin, Orca, Tiger Moth, Thresher: each within 10% of the mean on net control of space over 124 real-game matches) as Brood Rush's roster now, and hold the ten flagged hulls (Manta, Serpent, Grizzly, Jewel Wasp, Angler, Rhino, Jacks, Goby, Swordfish, Brittle Star) out until the redesign brings each in range. The Shrike's nest rework measured 1.09, so it may join first. Source: commits 2b94a1fda and b8f578023, Docs/ElementalLoop/REDESIGN.md.

Since 2026-11-19 every account holds one crew of 18 dealt from the 126 painted pilots (commit 5a34332f9). Make that dealt crew the start of this loop: recruiting becomes choosing which of your 18 to seat, and standing is earned per pilot of that crew, so the device-side standing stand-in and the dealt crew are one roster instead of two.

Kit drift check: Add a report check that flags a vessel whose abilities changed in the game while its kit in model/fleet/ did not. On 2026-11-19 the Rhino (Time is now Momentum with oversteer, Unstoppable and the Momentum ward are base, L5s Avalanche and Slingshot), the Shrike (trail almost nothing, a nest walled in super-shielded plates) and the Jewel Wasp (a possessed creature is stolen for good) all changed, and their fleet YAML still describes the old kits. The element-ability-table reader already reads the shipped ability maps, so the check can compare against it.

Tie each turn to a Tide so that players can see it coming, and announce it in the What's new window built 2026-11-21 (commit 56584fa4e, Frogma Rev 121 C): the turn's entry in WhatsNew.asset names which vessels changed and which arena environments are new, and the window opens once by itself after the update, so the hole's 'nothing tells a player that the meta turned' has its channel.

Every account holds one crew of 18 dealt from the painted pilots (commit 5a34332f9); since 2026-11-20 there are 180 of them in 10 full crews (commit b02766a07). Make that dealt crew the start of this loop: recruiting becomes choosing which of your 18 to seat, and standing is earned per pilot of that crew, so the device-side standing stand-in and the dealt crew are one roster instead of two.

Since 2026-11-21 the painted pool holds 324 pilots (PRs 2318, 2328: 17 roster crews, each pilot a species pair no earlier one had), and an account is dealt 18 of them once (PaintedCrewSO). Make the dealt crew the start of this loop and the other ~300 its recruit pool: "Recruit a pilot" at port offers someone outside your crew, a species pair you do not hold yet, and standing is earned per pilot. Each new painted batch then restocks the port, a reason to come back that the Returner persona lacks (loop_timescale_sim, PR 2338: Returner 12% at D30 with every fix).

Since 2026-11-22 the matrix spawns five grown creatures (Ray, Plume, Lantern, Ammon, Nettle), each in four element forms with a body of its own (PR #2327, Tools/Build/author_spawn_matrix_roster.py). Let 'play in what you made' include riding one: offer the Jewel Wasp beside a spawned creature, so the matrix becomes the free version of the Wasp's possession kit and the four forms are something a player feels, not only sees.

The Goby only moves perch to perch: Garrett's design: every move the Goby makes is a charged launch from one perch to the next. A tap is a short hop (140 u) and a full 0.8 s charge goes 600 u; the landing is always a perch, so short hops count too. While perched, the person's two thumbs turn the hull, and the turn sets the Pistol's plane. Today the Goby cruises between perches on two-thumb flight (its AI at aiCruiseSpeed 100), only darts that end 900 u or more from the last perch make a perch, and shorter ones are dashes.

Make ruins across the line the standard I4 demand on Time cards, beside the fauna. Since 2026-11-24 ten Time cards lay ruins at I4 only (Spearline, Headlong, Thornline, Scarab Rally, Switchback, Waystation, Slingshot, Grizzly Time, Breakwater's barriers, Brittle Star Time's breakers), each built on its own: write the shared rule into the I4 phase (which kinds, how far off the line, grows back once the field passes) so the next Time card starts from it. Sources: SPEARLINE.md, THORNLINE.md, HEADLONG.md, BREAKWATER.md, commits 78801c514, ebc817f9b, f6334e839.

Built in the game on Garrett's word (1a5ece719, 2026-11-24): the Goby is pinned at every landing, the two thumbs only turn it and set the Pistol's plane, and a 140-600 u dart by charge is its only movement; the seat AI and the Perch Run and Regatta coaches turn in place and hop aside when coral blocks the line. Perch Run's reader clocks stay 36.0 / 37.8 / 36.8 / 30.5 s. The atlas still shows this as an idea: it needs the owner's develop and done to reach Now, and the Goby's Proposed combo 'Length and line' describes what now ships.
